title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 6d. Strongly condemns the discrimination and human rights violations against women with intersectional identities, including those belonging to ethnic minorities such as Romani women; underlines that discrimination on any ground leads to rights violations in all spheres of life, including access to education, healthcare and in particular sexual and reproductive healthcare, work and access to justice;
